answer: The decision queue is no longer seeded from open-questions.md or resolution.md; section 6 rewritten to say so.
rationale: Those questions are the author's, waiting on measurements and product judgement no campaign has. Seeding them hands the loop a hundred provisional choices in code it has not written, and destroys the one signal the mechanism produces — a rising outstanding-DECISION- count means the loop is running ahead of its decisions, which it cannot mean if the count starts at a hundred.
